metadata.title: Bottled Breath
metadata.description: Bottle dragon breath and return End stone for careful study.

tracker.complete_text: The End stone samples are ready.

offer.label: Bottled Breath
lines: Dragon breath lingers above the End fountain, violet and entirely unwilling to be sensible.
Bottle a little of it, clear the staring locals, and bring stone for comparison.
Defeat 4 Endermen, then bring 4 dragon breath and 32 End stone. I will make the reward worth the trouble.
